visibility.description: Visibility tier. `shared` applies the group-permission map; `private` ignores groups and uses owner + sharedWith for access.

groupPermissions.description: Map of group UUID -> { use, manage } booleans. Empty object when visibility is `private`.
groupPermissions.title: Grouppermissions

sharedWith.description: Per-user share entries used for private-visibility agents.
sharedWith.title: Sharedwith

ownerUserId.description: Clerk user id of the agent owner. Set on first write for private agents.
ownerUserId.title: Owneruserid

ownerEmail.description: Lowercased email of the agent owner. Used by private-agent ACL when owner email matches.
ownerEmail.title: Owneremail

use.description: Whether members of this group may use (run / invoke) the agent.
use.title: Use

manage.description: Whether members of this group may manage (edit / deploy / delete) the agent.
manage.title: Manage

email.description: Lowercased email of a user explicitly granted access to a private agent.
email.title: Email

addedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which this user was added to the share list.
addedAt.title: Addedat

addedBy.description: Clerk user id of the principal that added this share entry.
addedBy.title: Addedby

userId.description: Clerk user id of the invited principal (optional — email is the primary key).
userId.title: Userid

trigger.description: `{trigger_type, schedule?}` blob. `trigger_type` is one of `schedule | webhook | api | slack | manual`.
trigger.title: Trigger

workflowStructure.description: Workflow graph (`{nodes, edges}`) for type=workflow agents. Null for type=task.
workflowStructure.title: Workflowstructure

agentSelection.description: Selected skills + per-step config (`{agents, model?}`) for type=task agents. Null for type=workflow.
agentSelection.title: Agentselection

pendingOwnerUserId.description: Clerk user id of the org member who will become owner once they accept.
pendingOwnerUserId.title: Pendingowneruserid

pendingOwnerEmail.description: Email of the pending recipient, resolved from org membership at request time.
pendingOwnerEmail.title: Pendingowneremail

requestedByUserId.description: Clerk user id of the member who requested the transfer (the current owner).
requestedByUserId.title: Requestedbyuserid

id.description: Numeric agent id (stable per-org; not reused after delete).
id.title: Id

slug.description: URL-safe slug used in human-readable links. Unique per org.
slug.title: Slug

name.description: Display name of the agent. Shown in the builder and in run logs.
name.title: Name

description.description: Optional one-paragraph description of what this agent does.
examples: Predicts churn risk for a customer given a 90-day usage window.
description.title: Description

status.description: Lifecycle status. `draft` = never deployed. `active` = deployed. `deleted` = soft-deleted.

type.description: Type of automation. `task` = single-step skill orchestration; `workflow` = multi-step graph.

orgUuid.description: Org UUID this agent belongs to. Matches the caller’s principal.
orgUuid.title: Orguuid

activeVariationId.description: Active (deployed) variation id. Null until the agent is first deployed.
activeVariationId.title: Activevariationid

draftVariationId.description: Most recent draft variation id. Null when there is no draft pending.
draftVariationId.title: Draftvariationid

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: True when the draft variation differs from the active variation (deploy would publish changes).
hasUnpublishedChanges.title: Hasunpublishedchanges

isEnabled.description: Whether the agent’s schedule is currently active. Toggle via POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/toggle.
isEnabled.title: Isenabled

accessConfig.description: Access configuration — who in the org can use / manage this agent.

pendingOwnershipTransfer.description: Pending ownership transfer awaiting recipient acceptance. Absent when no request is in flight.

variation.description: Variation-detail payload (`trigger`, `workflowStructure`, `agentSelection`) for the requested view. Populated by `GET /api/v1/agents/:id`; absent on list rows.

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp. Null for active agents.
deletedAt.title: Deletedat

canManage.description: Whether the requesting principal can manage (edit/delete/deploy/toggle) this agent. Derived server-side from the principal + accessConfig. Always present on every Agent response.
canManage.title: Canmanage

canUse.description: Whether the requesting principal can use (run, view history of) this agent. Derived server-side from the principal + accessConfig. Always present on every Agent response.
canUse.title: Canuse

manageDenial.description: Why `canManage` is false, for client-facing guidance: `needs_group_manage` (shared, but no group you belong to grants Manage) or `not_owner` (private, and you are not the owner). `null` when `canManage` is true. Derived server-side from the principal + accessConfig.
